headline: Contested Belt Keeps the Guns Roaring
war_summary: Since the last dispatch, the chief movement remains concentrated in the contested belt, though the ledger of holdings has changed little. WeatheredExpanse records 61 base events in the past day, including two in the latest two hours, with three Warden, three Colonial, and three neutral strategic bases; casualty rates remain heavy. LinnMercy is the freshest immediate flashpoint, logging six events in two hours and 14 across the day, chiefly around Outwich Ranch. MarbanHollow retains its mixed ledger and 35 daily events, but its last two hours were quiet. Gutter remains highly unsettled with 64 events, though none were recorded in the latest two hours. PariPeak has one recent event amid 19 for the day, while KuuraStrand’s earlier activity has fallen silent in the newest two-hour window after ten daily events. Beyond those ledgers, CallahansPassage and Stonecradle show sharply accelerating casualty rates without recorded base events, suggesting pressure without a confirmed ownership shift. Most rear sectors report little or no recent fighting.
